migrator-bot: New migration scheduled: add orders.shard_id + online index + backfill. Window request 2026-03-01 04:00-04:30 UTC. Estimated rows: 11.8M. Rate cap default 4k r/min. Please ack and pin API during window.
tara: Ack. Request soft hold at +7m to check p99.
kevin_db: Will set tourniquet and early abort on replica lag >25s or p99 >300ms. Backfill CLI: `./backfill --table orders --col shard_id --rate 4000 --checkpoint 4m --tourniquet-threshold 2`
sam_release: Pinning order-api now /deploybot pin order-api v3.2.0 --until 2026-03-01T04:45:00Z
deploybot: Deploybot: order-api pinned to v3.2.0 until 2026-03-01T04:45:00Z by sam_release.
olga: Oncall will monitor. Abort steps: 1) `deploybot abort-migration mig-20260301-01` 2) `DROP INDEX CONCURRENTLY idx_orders_shard;` 3) scale down workers 4) open #incidents.
oncall-sre: I'm on pager. Final preflight at 03:55 UTC and then greenlight.
